channel.title: RNZ Sport Headlines
channel.description: The Latest Sport headlines from RNZ News

item.title: All Blacks coach Dave Rennie expresses his dismay at 'crazy' World Cup draw
item.description: Dave Rennie has voiced his frustration at a Rugby World Cup draw that could see the All Blacks and Springboks meet in the quarters.

item.title: Cyclist Tom Sexton answers a world championship question
item.description: Southland cyclist Tom Sexton overcomes self-imposed pressure to grab a silver medal at the World Track Championships in Shanghai.

item.title: Auckland FC defend controversial Sam Cosgrove call ahead of A-League season opener
item.description: The English striker was sent off in an Intercontinental Cup game in August, but the club insists he served his two-match ban in National League fixtures.

item.title: Kiwis lose Kalyn Ponga to injury in major setback for Kiwis after loss to Australia
item.description: Ponga left the field with a suspected broken arm in the Kiwis 24-22 loss to Australia.

item.title: Rugby League: Kangaroos edge Kiwis in World Cup classic
item.description: In one of the most stunning starts to a sporting tournament, the Kiwis and Kangaroos played out an absolute classic to kick off the Rugby League World Cup.

item.title: A-League pay deal still not done as season kicks off
item.description: "Players shouldn't have to choose between football and family," says Wellington Phoenix midfielder CJ Bott on the eve of the A-League season.

item.title: Silver Ferns’ coach Dame Noeline Taurua says pressure on Australia
item.description: Constellation Cup shaping up to be the ultimate litmus test for the Ferns, as Dame Noeline Taurua prepares to mark her first time coaching the team in NZ in two years.

item.title: Fabian Holland returns for All Blacks as Dave Rennie rings changes for return Bledisloe Cup test
item.description: The lock is one of eight changes to the squad for the return Bledisloe Cup test against Australia in Sydney on Saturday.

item.title: Ryan Fox makes a big gear decision ahead of India Championship
item.description: Fox said it was just not worth the risk to use a driver on the tight Delhi course.

item.title: Wing Shyrah Tuliau-Tua'a named in Black Ferns team to face France
item.description: There are starting changes for Saturday's Test in Hamilton, from the side which lost narrowly to world champions England.

item.title: Union finally have a chance to win Heartland Championship trophy
item.description: The Heartland Championship trophy is named after the province's most famous player, Sir Colin Meads, now King Country finally has a chance to win it.

item.title: Carlin Davison stars as Breakers stun NBL defending champs
item.description: The Tall Blacks forward unleashes career-best numbers in a 102-101 upset of the Sydney Kings in Canberra.

item.title: Rugby League World Cup: Kiwis vs Australia - which is the greatest win ever?
item.description: There's nothing quite like the rare occassion the Kiwis finally get one up over the Kangaroos.

item.title: NZ and Australia collide in massive weekend of trans-Tasman sport
item.description: New Zealand and Australia are set to go head-to-head in rugby, league, cricket, and netball this weekend.
